# Customization

Flare UI is useful by default while allowing products to configure capabilities, actions, content, and targeted regions without forking the kit.

## Principle

The kit provides sensible defaults; capabilities own business availability; host configuration owns trimming and order; targeted extension points replace only what truly differs.

## Contract

[Themes](/en/customization/themes) · [Capabilities](/en/customization/capabilities) · [Actions](/en/customization/actions) · [Slots / Builders](/en/customization/slots-builders) · [Custom Message](/en/customization/custom-message) · [Custom Navigation](/en/customization/custom-navigation) · [Custom Composer](/en/customization/custom-composer) · [Custom Empty/Error](/en/customization/custom-empty-error) · [AppKit Overrides](/en/customization/app-kit-overrides)

## Platforms

Vue, Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI align semantically while retaining native syntax and interaction.

## Validation

Configuration tests cover defaults, removal, hiding, disabling, reordering, custom entries, and capability filtering.
